overview: The Lower Concourse is the subterranean infrastructure beneath Sanctus Seru’s industrial and civic districts.
history: Constructed to support industrial transport and maintenance operations.
Purity-screened tunnels were added to prevent ideological corruption.
Resonance cargo belts were introduced to stabilize arcane logistics.
Praetorian under-level patrols were integrated to enforce doctrinal compliance.
hooks: A cargo belt destabilizes, threatening a resonance cascade.
A maintenance tunnel reports a purity ward failure.
A Praetorian under-officer requests assistance with a sealed edict.
Workers report strange sounds from an unregistered tunnel.
